response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical leadership, mentoring abilities, and full-stack engineering competence, he falls significantly short on critical minimum qualifications. He has only approximately 6 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 8 years, and lacks evidence of the deep production-scale cloud infrastructure and compute specialization essential for this technical lead role. His career trajectory shows breadth across diverse technologies rather than the depth required in cloud compute platforms and large-scale distributed systems architecture.
strengths: Proven track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge sharing demonstrated through workshops, code dojos, and progression to Staff-level positions
Strong full-stack engineering capabilities and proven ability to adapt across diverse technologies and problem domains
Extensive experience building and maintaining infrastructure tooling, including GitLab, CI/CD servers, Docker, and Kubernetes deployments
concerns: Critical gap in C++ proficiency: only ~6 months of professional experience versus 8-year minimum requirement
Limited evidence of production-scale cloud compute platform design or leadership of cloud infrastructure teams
Career demonstrates generalist breadth across web, mobile, and various backends rather than deep specialization in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems
